title: Employ staff under the Storage Services and Wholesale Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Storage Services and Wholesale Award 2020.

sources.title: Storage Services and Wholesale Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the storage services and wholesale industry and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 12 — Classifications .

sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Storage and wholesale of goods (cl 4.2); employers covered by another award with classifications for these functions are excluded (cl 4.3).

assessment.summary: The Storage Services and Wholesale Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
